mapper.select: SELECT c.*, t.topic_name as topicName, u.avatar FROM content c LEFT JOIN topic t ON c.topic_id = t.id LEFT JOIN user u ON c.anonymous_id = u.anonymous_id JOIN `like` l ON c.id = l.target_id WHERE l.anonymous_id = #{anonymousId} AND l.target_type = 1 ORDER BY l.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
